nodes.summary: Let $S \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$, let $d \ge 1$, and let $M$ be a subcube of $\mathbb{N}^t$ with $S \subseteq M$. If $S$ is $d$-dense in $M$, then the gap size of $S$ satisfies $\operatorname{gs}(S) \le d$.
nodes.title: Density bounds the gap size

nodes.summary: Let $t \ge 1$. Every finite set $S \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$ has gap size $\operatorname{gs}(S) > 0$.
nodes.title: Finite sets in positive dimension have positive gap size

nodes.summary: For every point $x \in \mathbb{N}^t$, the one-point set $\lbrace x \rbrace$ has gap size $\operatorname{gs}(\lbrace x \rbrace) = 1$.
nodes.title: Gap size of a singleton

nodes.summary: For a set $S \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$, the gap size $\operatorname{gs}(S)$ is the least $d \ge 1$ such that $S$ is $d$-dense in some subcube of $\mathbb{N}^t$ that contains $S$. If no such $d$ exists (for instance when $S$ is unbounded, so that no subcube contains it), the value is $0$.
nodes.title: Gap size

nodes.summary: Let $r, t \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$. There is $A \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for every coloring of $\mathbb{N}^t$ with $r$ colors there are natural numbers $d \ge 1$ and $m > f(d)$, a color $j$, and a subcube $M$ of side $m$ with $M \subseteq [1, A]^t$ in which the class of color $j$ is $d$-dense. Here $[1, A]^t$ is the set of points $x$ with $1 \le x_i \le A$ for every coordinate $i$.
nodes.title: A color class is dense in a large subcube (Brown, Lemma 2)

nodes.summary: Let $r, t \in \mathbb{N}$ with $t \ge 1$, and let $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be nondecreasing. There is $B \in \mathbb{N}$ such that for every coloring of $\mathbb{N}^t$ with $r$ colors there is a finite monochromatic set $S \subseteq [1, B]^t$ with $|S| > f(\operatorname{gs}(S))$, where $\operatorname{gs}(S)$ is the gap size of $S$ and $[1, B]^t$ is the set of points $x$ with $1 \le x_i \le B$ for every…
nodes.title: Monochromatic sets that are large relative to their gap size

nodes.summary: Let $A \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$ be piecewise syndetic and let $A_1, \dots, A_r \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$ with $A = A_1 \cup \dots \cup A_r$. Then some $A_i$ is piecewise syndetic.
nodes.title: Piecewise syndeticity is partition regular

nodes.summary: Let $t, r \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $1 = m_0 < m_1 < m_2 < \cdots$ be a strictly increasing sequence of natural numbers. Let $M$ be a subcube of $\mathbb{N}^t$ of side $m_r$, and let $c$ be a coloring of $\mathbb{N}^t$ by natural numbers with $1 \le c(x) \le r$ for every $x \in M$. Then for some color $i$ with $1 \le i \le r$ there is a subcube $M' \subseteq M$ of side $m_i$ in which the class of color $i$ is…
nodes.title: A color class is dense in a subcube (Brown, Lemma 1)

nodes.summary: For sets $C, M \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$, the set $C$ is $1$-dense in $M$ if and only if $M \subseteq C$.
nodes.title: Density one means containment

nodes.summary: Let $d \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $C, M \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$. The set $C$ is $d$-dense in $M$ when every subcube of $\mathbb{N}^t$ of side $d$ that is contained in $M$ meets $C$.
nodes.title: Density in subcubes

nodes.summary: For every $t \in \mathbb{N}$, the whole space $\mathbb{N}^t$ is piecewise syndetic.
nodes.title: The whole space is piecewise syndetic

nodes.summary: Let $t \in \mathbb{N}$. A set $A \subseteq \mathbb{N}^t$ is piecewise syndetic if there is $d \in \mathbb{N}$ such that, writing $[0, d] = \{0, 1, \dots, d\}$, for every $m \in \mathbb{N}$ the set $A + [0, d]^t = \{y + z : y \in A,\ z \in [0, d]^t\}$ contains a lattice cube of side $m$.
nodes.title: Piecewise syndetic set

nodes.summary: For $t \in \mathbb{N}$ and $a \in \mathbb{N}^t$, the lattice cube with least corner $a$ and side $1$ is the singleton $\{a\}$.
nodes.title: Lattice cube of side one

nodes.summary: For $t, m \in \mathbb{N}$ and $a \in \mathbb{N}^t$, the lattice cube with least corner $a$ and side $m$ is the set of points $x \in \mathbb{N}^t$ such that $a_i \le x_i < a_i + m$ for every coordinate $i$; it is a subcube of size $m^t$.
nodes.title: Lattice cube

nodes.summary: For $t, m \in \mathbb{N}$ and $a, x \in \mathbb{N}^t$, the point $x$ lies in the lattice cube with least corner $a$ and side $m$ if and only if $a_i \le x_i < a_i + m$ for every coordinate $i$.
nodes.title: Membership in a lattice cube

nodes.summary: For every $t \in \mathbb{N}$, the empty subset of $\mathbb{N}^t$ is not piecewise syndetic.
nodes.title: The empty set is not piecewise syndetic

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
